comments.text:
Implement EqSection Vizia view with 3-band parametric EQ controls.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.7 (SynthKnob)

Visual: Compact panel with EQ on/off switch + 7 knobs (Low Freq, Low Gain, Mid Freq, Mid Gain, Mid Q, High Freq, High Gain). Matches the collapsible EQ in web mixer channel strips.

REFERENCE:
- web/src/EqSection.tsx: complete React implementation
- web/src/EqKnob.tsx: the smaller knob variant used in EQ/sends

Place in crates/integral-vst/src/views/.

title: VST/Vizia: implement EqSection with 3-band parametric controls
